credits: repeat98: a development fixture of the Octatrack base's program areas

presentation.label: DEV FIXTURE
presentation.summary: Development fixture for the base's program areas: knob A picks one of eight programs whose DSP cost tells which one runs. Never published.
presentation.overview: Each program is a DO loop the base writes into the area its slot does not run and then names in the slot's record between two frames. The audio passes untouched.
highlights: Eight programs, 100 + 500 x program DSP cycles a call
The DSP meter of the slot's core tells which program runs
usage: Try it on a development twin of the base's cumulative draft (README.md), pick PROG PROBE on an audio track's FX2, turn A.

limitations: Development fixture, never published: it needs a base with program areas (the 0.8.3 cumulative draft's development twins).

tests.summary: sdk/tests/test_dsp_programs.py: the base's areas and the contract's proc. Unit runs in the base's cumulative pull request.

license.declaration: Modwerk's own code. No Elektron firmware, routines or tables are included.

access.location: Audio track FX2 SETUP: PROG PROBE in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX2 to open FX2 SETUP.
Turn LEVEL to PROG PROBE and press YES.
Press FX2 for the main page: PROG on knob A.
